title: Sofron Pack oCd
description: Your favorite texture pack, continuously updated for over 8 years
body:
# **About**
After more than 8 years of staying true to its classic design, the oCd pack has been continuously updated while preserving its original identity. Now, Sofron oCd is ready for a new chapter. It's time to bring fresh ideas to the pack while preserving the iconic charm that made it so beloved.

# **FAQ**
-  Can I use this resource pack in videos or modpacks?
    - Yes, you can :)
- Can I create my own resource pack based on this?
  - For personal use only. If you wish to use, modify, or redistribute any part of it, please ask for permission first :)
